title: Princeton anomalies research lab
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Princeton anomalies research lab, about unspecified at Princeton University, New Jersey, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a research lab at Princeton University in New Jersey that studied anomalies, meaning strange things science cannot easily explain. He brings it up as an example of serious places that looked into such questions.
